sentences.text: This lake killed seventeen hundred people while they slept.
In August nineteen eighty-six, a lake in Cameroon looked perfectly calm.
A cloud of carbon dioxide, heavier than air, rolled down the valley like a sheet of invisible water.
It crept into villages while people slept.
More than seventeen hundred people died, and so did their livestock.
Nobody saw it coming, because you cannot see gas.
The lake had been quietly collecting it from below for years.
